Translating technical terms accurately is crucial for clarity. The main challenge will be finding equivalent terms in German that convey the same meaning without being too literal or awkward.

Starting with "The maximum number": In German, this would typically be "Die maximale Anzahl".

Next, "past conversation summaries": Here, "past" translates to "vergangener", and since it's modifying a noun phrase (conversation summaries), it should be placed before the noun in German. So maybe something like "... vergangener Gesprächszusammenfassungen".

"Include in prompts": The word for include here could be either einbeziehen or berücksichtigen; however, einbeziehen might fit better as it implies including into something actively. Prompts can stay as Prompts if there's no direct translation commonly used; sometimes technical terms remain in English even when translated into other languages.
